# SummaryRow

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:summary-row` · Kerf UI · component · Structure

A selectable option or static diagnostic group as a list row or board card, with a state rail, a clamped title, trailing meta, and a metadata line.

## When to use

Present dense item summaries (tickets, tasks, messages) as selectable list rows or board cards with Kerf-owned selection, hover, focus, rail, clamping, list-edge rounding, and narrow compaction, without app row CSS.

- A list or board shows many items as dense, selectable summaries with an identifier, a title, a timestamp, and metadata.
- An unreadable item needs the same summary chrome with a nested recovery action but must be a labeled non-option group.

**Not when:**

- Do not use for navigation rows with a single label; use ListItem.
- Do not use for selectable tiles of free-form content; use ContentItem with selectionMode.
- Do not hand-roll row chrome (selection fill, rail, title clamp, edge rounding) in app CSS.

**Alternatives:**

- [ListItem](./list-item.md) (nearest) — Use ListItem for navigation rows.
- [ContentItem](./content-item.md) (nearest) — Use ContentItem for selectable rich tiles.

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/summary-row` — exports `SummaryRow`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/summary-row` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/summary-row.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

## Props

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/summary-row`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuisummary-row) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

**Variants (configure, do not restyle):**

- row
- card
- selected
- dimmed
- state rail
- list edge start, end, or only
- title line budget
- deferred rendering
- static labeled group with a nested action (semanticRole=group)

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`.
- Children: unrestricted.

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** the listbox container, selection set, and keyboard movement; the title, leading glyph, trailing meta, and metadata content; rail tone and dimming policy.

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: none · border: self · padding: self (layout role: structure). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

- Rows sit flush in a list section and round only the corners at its edges; cards are borderless rounded cards.

## Accessibility

- By default SummaryRow is role=option with tabindex=0 and aria-selected; place options in a labeled role=listbox and move focus with the arrow keys in the app. semanticRole=group requires ariaLabel and omits the root Tab stop and aria-selected, so a nested native action owns focus and activation. The rail is decorative; carry its meaning in text.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-summary-row`, `kui-summary-row__rail`, `kui-summary-row__body`, `kui-summary-row__leading`, `kui-summary-row__content`, `kui-summary-row__title`, `kui-summary-row__trailing`, `kui-summary-row__metadata`.

Never put `kui-summary-row`, `kui-summary-row__rail`, `kui-summary-row__body`, `kui-summary-row__leading`, `kui-summary-row__content`, `kui-summary-row__title`, `kui-summary-row__trailing`, `kui-summary-row__metadata` on an element you write; render `SummaryRow` instead (`KUI-L103`).
